origins.neoorigins.abyssal.name: Ko Abyssal
origins.neoorigins.abyssal.description: He mea ora o te hohonu , he mea whakangungu, he tere i te wai, he kaha ki te karanga i nga kaitiaki kaitiaki.
power.neoorigins.abyssal_water_breathing: Ko te manawa o te ngaru
E manawa ana i te wai kia rite ki te hau, ā, ka kite mārama i roto i a ia me te kore e pōuri.
power.neoorigins.aquatic_underwater_mini: Ko nga maina kei te tere tonu i te wa e ngaru ana.
power.neoorigins.aquatic_depth_strider.d: Ka neke wawe ake i roto i te wai.
power.neoorigins.aquatic_swim_speed.name: Te wai tuwhera
power.neoorigins.aquatic_swim_speed.desc: He tino mawhiti i te awa moana, ehara i te mea i te taha anake.
power.neoorigins.aquatic_buoyancy.name: Ko te Pūwhinga Pūwhinga
power.neoorigins.aquatic_buoyancy.descri: Ka mau tonu te hohonu i te wā e tino uru ana, kaua e hinga.
power.neoorigins.aquatic_fish_diet.name: Ko te kai ika
power.neoorigins.aquatic_fish_diet.descr: Ka taea te kai i te ika anake. Ka taea e nga kaiwhakahaere tūmau te whakakore i tenei i te whirihoranga (ocean_origins.fish_diet_required).
power.neoorigins.aquatic_fish_diet_bonus: Te Whakapā Mai i te Raw
He kai te raau o te kaikawe me te raumonā rite tonu ki ngā putanga tunu.
power.neoorigins.abyssal_aquatic_speed.d: Ka neke i roto i te wai me te kaha, pūngao tōtika tere ake i te tangata o te mata.
power.neoorigins.abyssal_night_vision.de: Ko nga kanohi kua whakaritea ki te pouri tino. Whakamahia te paatene Night Vision (K taunoa).
power.neoorigins.abyssal_thorns_aura.des: Ka whakahokia 30% o nga kino i riro mai ki nga kaiwhaiwhai.
power.neoorigins.abyssal_natural_armor.n: Ko te kiri e pakaru ana
power.neoorigins.abyssal_natural_armor.d: +2 ngā ngakau (+4 HP mōrahi). Ko te koiora o te moana hohonu e hanga ana i tētahi anga pakeke ake.
power.neoorigins.abyssal_underwater_mini: Ko nga maina kei te tere tonu, ahakoa i te wa e ngaru ana.
Ka ora haere i te wai tata ki te 1 HP ia 3 hēkona.
power.neoorigins.abyssal_daylight_damage: Ko te Rangatiratanga o te Mata
E 1.5 nga kino i ia hēkona ka tukuna ki te mahana o te ra.
power.neoorigins.abyssal_land_speed_pena: E neke ana i te 10% iti ake i runga i te whenua.
power.neoorigins.abyssal_dries_out.name: Ka maroke
power.neoorigins.abyssal_dries_out.descr: Ka heke te hau i te wa e kore ai koe e wai: he roa rawa te mata, a ka mate koe. Ko te ua, ko te kohua wai, ko te manawa wai, ko te rori mahi tata rānei, e aukati ana i a koe.
origins.neoorigins.voidwalker.name: Ka haereere
origins.neoorigins.voidwalker.descriptio: Ko te mea e pa ana ki te Whakamutunga e haere ana i roto i nga waahanga, e pupuhi ana i nga tawhiti poto, e haere ana i te kore e kitea e te nuinga o nga whakawehi.
power.neoorigins.voidwalker_active_telep: He karapa ki te wahi e titiro ana koe (tae atu ki te 24 kōpae). He 2 te utu o te pūngao.
power.neoorigins.voidwalker_night_vision: Ka taea te kite i te pouri katoa. Whakamahia te paatene Night Vision (K taunoa).
E kore e kite te iwi i a koe, ki te kore koe e whakaekehia.
power.neoorigins.voidwalker_water_damage: Ka tango i te 1 kino ia hēkona i roto i te wai, i te ua ranei ka wehi te waimarie i te wai.
power.neoorigins.voidwalker_no_hunger_sp: Kāore he utu nui o te kai i te rere.
origins.neoorigins.stoneguard.name: Ko te Kaitiaki
origins.neoorigins.stoneguard.descriptio: I whanau mai i te kohatu ora he kaitiaki kore e pakaru e maka ana i nga tarutaru ki nga kaiwhaiwhai, e keri ana i te kohatu me nga ringaringa noa, e tuku ana i nga rama o te kohatu ki te pouri.
power.neoorigins.stoneguard_natural_armo: +3 ngā ngakau (+6 HP mōrahi). He nui ake te kai o te tinana kohatu i te kikokiko.
E whakahoki ana i te 20% o nga kino i riro mai i nga kaiwhaiwhai.
power.neoorigins.stoneguard_knockback_re: He 50% te ātete ki te whakaheke.
power.neoorigins.stoneguard_slow_movemen: E neke ana i te 10% tere ake i te tangata noa.
power.neoorigins.stoneguard_stone_mining: E rua nga wa te tere o te pakaru.
power.neoorigins.stoneguard_no_mob_spawn: Kaore nga monsters e whanau i roto i te 48 wharepaku.
origins.neoorigins.verdant.name: He mea whakamiharo
origins.neoorigins.verdant.description: He whakapakoko ora o te ao matomato kaore i te mamae, i te rangimarie me te taiao, engari kua tino whakangaromia e te kino o te Nether.
power.neoorigins.verdant_mobs_ignore.nam: Ko te whanaunga o te mohoao
power.neoorigins.verdant_mobs_ignore.des: Ko nga hui katoa tae atu ki nga hunga hoariri e wareware ana ki a koe ki te kore e whakaoho.
Ko nga pakiaka e whakaiti ana i ia hinganga.
power.neoorigins.verdant_no_hunger_sprin: Kāore he utu nui o te kai i te rere.
power.neoorigins.verdant_forest_regen.de: Ka whakahoutia te hauora i te wa e noho ana i roto i nga koiora ngahere.
power.neoorigins.verdant_nether_damage.d: E rua ngā kino i te hēkona i te wā e noho ana i te Nether.
origins.neoorigins.umbral.name: Ko te parauri
origins.neoorigins.umbral.description: He tamaiti o te atarangi e maka ana i ngā pūngao pōuri, e rere ana i waenganui i ngā tūnga, e huri ana i ngā pere.
power.neoorigins.umbral_night_vision.des: Ka kite tino i te pouri katoa. Whakamahia te paatene Night Vision (K taunoa).
power.neoorigins.umbral_active_dash.name: Ko te Pūpū o te atarangi
power.neoorigins.umbral_active_dash.desc: Ka pupuhi ki mua i te tere nui i te aronga e neke ana koe, e rua ngā pūngao e utu ana.
Ka tango i te 1 kino ia hēkona ina whakauruhia ki te mahana o te ra.
power.neoorigins.umbral_projectile_immun: Ko te Taahiraa o te atarangi
E haere ana ngā pere i roto i tō āhua e pā ana ki te atarangi.
power.neoorigins.umbral_no_hunger_sprint: Kāore he utu nui o te kai i te rere.
power.neoorigins.umbral_shadow_orb.name: Ko te Orb o te atarangi
power.neoorigins.umbral_shadow_orb.descr: Whakanohoia he porowhita kore e kitea e whakanohoia ana ki te pouri i roto i te porowhita o te 28 o nga karaehe. E wha nga porowhita e mahi ana i te wa kotahi; te whakanoho i tetahi hou ka tango i te mea tawhito. E rua nga kaha e utu ana.
power.neoorigins.feline_active_launch.de: E pupuhi ana i a koe i te huarahi e titiro ana koe. E rua ngā pūngao, e wha ngā hēkona te whakawera.
power.neoorigins.draconic_flight.name: Nga Rapa o te Rakau
power.neoorigins.draconic_flight.descrip: E rere noa ana i te rangi mā te whakamahi i ngā parirau draconic kaha.
power.neoorigins.draconic_active_firebal: Ka pupuhi i te pupuhi o ngā pōro ahi iti e wha ki te aronga e titiro ana koe.
power.neoorigins.sylvan_crop_growth.name: Ko te Manaakitanga o te Ora
power.neoorigins.sylvan_crop_growth.desc: Ka tere ake te tipu o ngā hua tata ki a koe, me te mea kua manaakitia e te whenua.
power.neoorigins.sylvan_active_root.name: Te whakakotahitanga
power.neoorigins.sylvan_active_root.desc: Ka whakatohia ngā mea ora katoa i te taha o te wāhi me te pūmau o te Rōpū VI mō te 4 hēkona.
power.neoorigins.revenant_active_phase.d: Ngā wāhanga i roto i te taiepa mārō i roto i te aronga e titiro ana koe.
power.neoorigins.revenant_active_bolt.de: E pupuhi ana i tētahi pūngao e pakaru ana, e pupuhi ana ki tētahi rohe o te hau kino. E utu ana i te pūngao kotahi.
power.neoorigins.abyssal_starting_triden: Ka whakawhiwhia ki a koe he trident whakamiharo kaha (Mending, Unbreaking III, Riptide III) ka whiriwhiri koe i tenei takenga.
power.neoorigins.abyssal_scare_ocean.des: Ko nga mea ora o te moana te kaimana, te ika, te dolphin e rere ana i a koe i te kitenga.
power.neoorigins.voidwalker_active_phase: Whakamahia he taiepa mārō i te aronga e titiro ana koe.
power.neoorigins.stoneguard_active_glows: Ka whakanohoia e ia tētahi kōhatu māramatanga ki te mata e titiro ana koe.
power.neoorigins.verdant_harvest_bonus.d: Ko te pakaru i ngā hua pakeke, i ngā rākau rānei, ka puta mai he huinga anō o ngā matotoru.
power.neoorigins.summon_minion.not_enoug: Kaore e nui te hiakai ki te karanga!
item.neoorigins.orb_of_origin: Ko te Orb o te Takenga
item.neoorigins.orb_of_origin.not_enough: E hiahia ana koe ki ngā taumata wheako %s hei whakamahi i tēnei.
jei.neoorigins.orb_of_origin.info: Whakatūnga anō ngā kōwhiringa takenga katoa me te whakatuwhera anō i te tīpako takenga. utu 5 taumata XP i te whakamahi o mua (te whakamahi tuatahi e kore utu). Whakamahia i runga i te whakamahi.
emi.neoorigins.orb_of_origin.info: Whakatūnga anō ngā kōwhiringa takenga katoa me te whakatuwhera anō i te tīpako takenga. utu 5 taumata XP i te whakamahi o mua (te whakamahi tuatahi e kore utu). Whakamahia i runga i te whakamahi.
item.neoorigins.orb_of_class: Ko te Orb o te Karaehe
item.neoorigins.orb_of_class.not_enough_: E hiahia ana koe ki ngā taumata wheako %s hei whakamahi i tēnei.
jei.neoorigins.orb_of_class.info: Whakatūnga anake i tō kōwhiringa kōwae me te whakatuwhera anō i te kōwhiringa kōwae, te pupuri i tō takenga matua. utu 2 taumata XP ia whakamahi. kai i runga i te whakamahi.
emi.neoorigins.orb_of_class.info: Whakatūnga anake i tō kōwhiringa kōwae me te whakatuwhera anō i te kōwhiringa kōwae, te pupuri i tō takenga matua. utu 2 taumata XP ia whakamahi. kai i runga i te whakamahi.
origins.neoorigins.inchling.name: Te whakakii
origins.neoorigins.inchling.description: Ko tētahi tangata-whāwhā-whāwhā, e hāngai ana ki ngā pakitara, e neke ana i te tere ohorere, engari he tinana ngoikore kei te haere tahi me te rohe.
power.neoorigins.inchling_size.name: Te whakaiti
power.neoorigins.inchling_size.descripti: Kotahi noa iho o te rahi noa.
Ka taea te piri ki te neke i tetahi mata.
power.neoorigins.inchling_no_fall_damage: He maama rawa te mea kāore e mamae te hinga.
power.neoorigins.inchling_reduced_health: -5 ngā ngakau (-10 HP mōrahi). Ko te tinana o te hauwhā te wahi e whā o te whiu.
power.neoorigins.inchling_speed_boost.de: He tere ake te 15% i te ritenga noa.
power.neoorigins.inchling_hunger_efficie: Ka mate te hiakai i te haurua o te tere o te kaitākaro noa.
origins.neoorigins.sporeling.name: Te whakakakahu
origins.neoorigins.sporeling.description: He mea ora huaketo e tupu ana i te pouri me nga mara huaketo e whakakii ana i nga huaketo huaketo, engari e pakaru ana i te mahana o te ra.
power.neoorigins.sporeling_spore_cloud.d: E pupuhi ana i tētahi pūtaiao pūtaiao e pupuhi ana i roto i tētahi kapua o ngā pūtaiao pūtaiao.
power.neoorigins.sporeling_poison_immuni: He ārai ki ngā pānga mate katoa.
Ka taea te kite mārama i roto i te pouri katoa. Whakamahia te paatene Night Vision (te taunoa K).
